### Which side of the change is the refusal

Every rule in `agent/1` is a refusal with a vector named for it. A proposed
rule names the document it would refuse; a proposed relaxation names the
document it would start accepting. "I do not know which of us is correct" is a
complete answer and often the accurate one.
